scope: accept one matching pair of surrounding single or double quotes around an otherwise valid existing key value
preserve an original literal 32-byte key as the first candidate
leave the GoDaddy app, database, secrets and all other GoDaddy resources unchanged

host_observation.reason: The process exited in configuration validation because DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY was not accepted as a supported 32-byte key. The secret value was neither read nor logged.

source_changes: The parser first considers the supplied value exactly as stored.
When the first and final characters are one matching quote pair, it also considers only the inner value through the same strict canonical Base64URL, Base64, hexadecimal or literal-byte checks.
No key is derived, truncated, replaced or logged.

observations: The focused assertions exercise padded Base64URL, hexadecimal and standard Base64 values inside matching quotes.
A 32-byte literal whose first and final characters are quotes retains its original bytes.

hosted_verification.evidence: The GoDaddy dashboard reports both Preview infrastructure and site status OK for the pushed R-04 commit.
hosted_verification.limitation: A direct secretless /healthz navigation from browser automation was blocked by the local client before it reached the host; the provider health status is the hosted evidence recorded here.
